add.label: mandatory religious zakat paid through the employer is an allowed deduction in withholding

source.quote: zakat atau sumbangan keagamaan yang sifatnya wajib bagi pemeluk agama yang diakui di Indonesia, yang dibayarkan melalui pemberi kerja kepada badan amil zakat, lembaga amil zakat, dan lembaga keagamaan yang dibentuk atau disahkan oleh pemerintah.
Peraturan Menteri ini mulai berlaku pada tanggal 1 Januari 2024.

initial_delta.note: The TER method for non-final periods, the annual recomputation in the final period, the part-year proportional rule, job expense limits (5%, Rp6.000.000/year, Rp500.000/month) and PTKP rules are already in the KB with unchanged values, so only the new zakat deduction through the employer (Pasal 10 ayat (1) huruf c) is added from 1 January 2024. It feeds the existing annual zakat deduction. The PER-16 annualised monthly rules are already superseded by REG.TER.RUNNING and are not closed here, because this PMK does not revoke PER-16 itself.

output.reason: PMK 168/2023 replaces PMK 252/PMK.03/2008 and PMK 250/PMK.03/2008. It sets a new PPh 21 calculation method for permanent employees (Pegawai Tetap). For each tax period other than the last, tax is the monthly effective rate (TER) multiplied by monthly gross income. In the last tax period (December or the month of termination), tax is recomputed annually using the Article 17 progressive rates, minus the tax already withheld. The regulation also defines the components of gross income, including employer-paid JKK/JKM, BPJS Kesehatan and insurance premiums. It sets the deductions: occupational expense at 5% up to Rp6,000,000 per year or Rp500,000 per month, pension/old-age contributions and zakat. It sets PTKP rules for female employees, rounding of taxable income down to full thousands, and annualisation for partial-year employees. It applies from 1 January 2024.
